Survey sample and full working gas estimates
- Survey Sample Est. Full Work- Yr-Ago
(5)This Week regional and Total U.S. volumes divided by Estimated Full regional and Total U.S. volumes. This statistic is intended to show how "full" working gas is at any given time.

(6)This percentage value describes the survey sample size each week (sample may change if companies fail to report or a company is added to the weekly survey). It is determined by dividing the maximum volume held in recent years in reported pools for all the reporting companies in a given region for that week by that regions estimated full. Any additions to the sample or failures to report are reflected in a percentage change from the prior week.

*In the Producing Region, 10 Bcf was reclassified by one company from base to working gas. The increase is recorded as a change to "estimated full" in the Producing Region from 908 Bcf to 918 Bcf. Likewise, the total U.S. "estimated full" increases from 3,180 Bcf to 3,190 Bcf. For this week, the reclassification has contributed to the positive increase shown in working gas volumes for the Producing Region. Without the reclassification, the Producing Region volume would have been down 7 Bcf from the previous week.
